## Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see.

## Motivation
Explain why you think this feature would be useful and how it would improve Acro DJ Mixer.

## Example Use Case
Describe a real-world scenario where this feature would be beneficial.

## Proposed Implementation
Optional: Describe how you think this feature could be implemented.

## Alternatives
Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have checked existing issues for similar feature requests
- [ ] This feature is not already implemented
- [ ] I have provided a clear motivation for this feature
